coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 8 ground-truth variables (38%, rounded): both query directions, retrieval accuracy/log-likelihood, and chat-style versus completion-style interaction through instruction-model QA and base-model cloze evaluation.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed IMDb top-1000/GPT-4-verified dataset with Wikidata cohorts and substitutes different models for all specified models. Fixes temperature at 0 rather than varying it by model and context. Does not specify the required constant evaluation scripts. Uses McNemar tests and mixed-effects regression instead of the specified t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not match the expected directional-bias conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied stating that child-to-parent retrieval should outperform parent-to-child retrieval, confirming the reversal curse.
